hero.title: BBA / BBA (Hons.) Majoring in Business Analytics

panes.label: Overview
panes.text:
The BBA / BBA (Hons.) in Business Analytics at ATLAS ISME is designed for aspiring data strategists who can transform complex information into actionable business intelligence. The programme builds a strong foundation in data analytics, visualisation, and business decision sciences, preparing students to navigate the evolving digital economy with analytical precision.

You will learn by solving through real-world datasets, live analytics projects, AI-driven case studies, and industry-led masterclasses. From marketing analytics to financial modelling, each concept is rooted in practical business contexts. By the end of the programme, you will be equipped to convert data into strategy, optimise business performance, and drive innovation across global corporations, consulting firms, or your own entrepreneurial ventures.

cards.title: Understand data, analytics and business drivers
Design data-driven strategies for marketing, finance, HR and operations
Use advanced tools to generate actionable insights
Translate insights into strategies that drive growth and efficiency
Evaluate customer, market and workforce data for better outcomes
Leverage emerging analytics technologies to enhance decision-making
Marketing
cards.text: Go beyond the fundamentals of branding and consumer behaviour. The Marketing minor equips you to develop impactful campaigns, understand audience insights and build standout brands in today’s competitive landscape.

cards.title: Finance
cards.text: Master key financial concepts, including investment, valuation, and budgeting, to drive organisational growth. The Finance minor prepares you for careers in corporate finance, banking and investment management.

cards.title: Entrepreneurship
cards.text: Transform ideas into action by learning to launch ventures and drive innovation. This minor sharpens your creativity, leadership and problem-solving through real-world projects and collaboration.

cards.title: Economics
cards.text: Explore the economic forces and policies shaping global businesses and markets. Learn how economic analysis informs decision-making and drives innovation through public policy

cards.title: AI & Emerging Technologies
cards.text: Understand how AI, machine learning and emerging technologies are reshaping industries and driving innovation, efficiency and growth.

cards.title: Digital Branding & Advertising
cards.text: Master digital marketing strategies, create compelling brand identities, and design effective campaigns to engage and grow online audiences.

cards.title: Business Psychology
cards.text: Explore how psychological principles influence workplace behaviour, leadership, decision-making and team dynamics to optimise performance and culture

courses.text: Learn the core management functions of planning, organising, leading and controlling to effectively manage teams and organisations.
Understand key marketing strategies and how consumer psychology influences purchasing decisions to create impactful campaigns.
Explore behavioural patterns, cultural influences and psychological principles that shape individual and collective decision-making.
